children: Curtiss-Wright expanded its stock buyback authorization by $510 million, and said it plans to immediately repurchase $100 million worth of shares.

The company said the board's new buyback authorization brings the total available authorization to $700 million. The immediate $100 million buyback will be executed using a 10b5-1 program, the company said.
Last month, Curtiss-Wright twice expanded its buyback authorization by $100 million, and executed an additional $100 million in conditional buybacks.
The company expects buybacks in 2026 to total $460 million, with an open buyback authorization of $600 million entering 2027.
"This up-sized authorization reflects our Board's confidence in Curtiss-Wright's Pivot to Growth strategy, healthy balance sheet and strong financial outlook," Chief Executive Lynn Bamford said.
